title: Scarlet Witch Pose Sequence
description: Four side-by-side panels show a Black woman with long flowing white hair wearing a red and black Scarlet Witch-inspired outfit. She progresses through magical poses: holding glowing red energy in her hands, raising both hands to summon symbols, projecting intense red energy blasts, and finally standing in a dynamic stance with energy dissipating.
